title: Wholesale Catalytic Converters for Auto Shops | Converter Express
description: Source Converter Unlimited catalytic converters for your auto shop. Browse by series, check vehicle applications, and order with delivery in Sacramento, Stockton and the Bay Area.
heading: The right converter. A simpler way to order.
intro: Converter Express supplies catalytic converters to automotive repair and exhaust shops in Sacramento, Stockton, and the Bay Area. Explore the Converter Unlimited catalog, check vehicle applications, and manage your shop’s orders in one place.

sections.heading: Find parts by series or vehicle
sections.text: Browse the 201, 202, 1000/2000, 5000, 5900, 7000, and 92000 series. If you already know your part number, use the catalog to find it directly. If you are starting with a vehicle, use the compatibility lookup with its year, make, model, engine size, and emissions test group.
sections.label: Browse the converter catalog

sections.heading: Confirm the application before ordering
sections.text: Match the listed application, converter position, and emissions test group to the vehicle. Review the relevant approval document and installation requirements. Universal converters also require inlet, outlet, sizing, and routing checks; a search result alone does not confirm physical fit.
sections.label: Check vehicle compatibility

sections.heading: Order through your shop account
sections.text: Apply for a shop account to access wholesale pricing after approval. Your account brings together ordering, order records, and delivery details. New approved shops receive $50 off their first order, applied at checkout. Confirm current pricing and availability before planning the job.
sections.label: Apply for a shop account

intro: Converter Express offers free same-day delivery of in-stock parts to automotive shops in Sacramento, Stockton, and the Bay Area. sections.heading: Sacramento, Stockton, and the Bay Area
sections.text: Our delivery service is built around shops in these three service areas. Add your shop’s delivery address to your account so each order has the information needed to reach you. Contact us to confirm coverage for your specific address and timing for your order.
sections.label: Ask about your delivery

sections.heading: A clear order starts with the right details
sections.text: Choose your parts and quantities, confirm the vehicle application, and provide the shop address and any delivery notes. Check current stock and order status in your account. Same-day delivery availability for a particular order should be confirmed before you promise a completion time to your customer.
sections.label: Open your shop account

sections.heading: Your first order starts with $50 off
sections.text: Approved shops receive $50 off their first order at checkout. Combine convenient shop delivery with a catalog organized by converter series and vehicle application. Need help choosing a part? Include the vehicle details and emissions test group when you contact us.
